task: Flip ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION's default from off to on (owner directive) — closes the gap where tts_parallel_cap's default was raised 1->2 (92bbb443) but the actual admission gate letting concurrent segment rendering happen stayed off, so renders were still fully sequential regardless of the cap setting.

app/orchestration/scheduler/resources.py.summary: _engine_class_admission_enabled() now defaults to True (per-engine-class semaphore admission active) unless ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION is explicitly set to "0"/"false"/"no"/"off"; previously defaulted False unless explicitly set to a truthy value. Module docstring's 'ships dark, default cap=1' note updated to describe the new default-on posture.

tests/orchestration/test_engine_semaphor.summary: TestShipsDarkCrossClassSerialization renamed to TestPerClassAdmissionDefault: added test_cross_class_concurrent_by_default (env unset -> concurrent admission), renamed the old default-off assertion to test_cross_class_serializes_when_explicitly_disabled (now sets ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION=0 explicitly). test_xtts_serialized_through_real_path now forces tts_parallel_cap=1 and resets the grow-only per-engine-id 'xtts' semaphore cache, since the manifest/global defaults are both 2 now and would otherwise admit both tasks.

tests/orchestration/test_eta_bracket_and.summary: test_currently_live_engines_unaffected_toggle_off now explicitly sets ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION=0 instead of relying on it as an ambient default.

design-docs/specs/queue-jobs.md.summary: spec_version 1.11.5 -> 1.11.6. §7.3a rewritten: per-engine-class admission gate now documented as default ON (was 'ships-dark, default OFF'); explicit disable via ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION=0/false/no/off. §7.4 admission-order step 2 updated to match ('legacy fallback' instead of 'ships-dark gate'). New changelog row 1.11.6 added.

flow_impact: none — no flow entries reference ENGINE_CLASS_ADMISSION by name; the admission-order description inside any existing synthesis-dispatch flow's 'invariant'/'failure_modes' strings that mention 'ships dark'/'default off' should be checked at next consolidation.
